# MDL103 · `carriage-return`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

The file contains carriage returns (Windows CRLF line endings).

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | loading |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | safe |
| Flags | unsuppressible |
| Design references | K1, cases 05, 36, 45, 47 |

## Why

GLib removes a `\r` right before `\n`, so key/value lines with CRLF endings are read correctly. mydumper's pre-processor does not: it counts the `\r` as content. An empty line (`\r\n`) therefore becomes `\r= 1`, a key/value pair with an empty key, and GLib rejects the whole file. A CRLF file is one empty line away from being ignored.

A carriage return that is not part of a line ending stays in the text GLib returns, for example at the end of a value.

## Example

❌ Before:

```text
[mydumper]\r
routines=1\r
\r
events=1\r
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

```text
1:11-1:12 error MDL103[carriage-return] file uses Windows (CRLF) line endings (4 lines)
  = mydumper ignores this entire file: it only logs a WARNING ("Failed to load config file") and runs with its defaults, exit code 0.
  fix (safe): Convert the line endings to LF
3:1-3:2 error MDL103[carriage-return] empty line with a Windows (CRLF) line ending: mydumper's pre-processor turns it into `\r= 1`, a key/value pair with an empty key (GLib: Key file contains line “\r= 1” which is not a key-value pair, group, or comment)
  = mydumper ignores this entire file: it only logs a WARNING ("Failed to load config file") and runs with its defaults, exit code 0.
  fix (safe): Remove the carriage returns of this empty line
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
routines=1

events=1
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL103: warning   # or error, info, off
```

Its diagnostics mean mydumper ignores the whole file: they cannot be suppressed by comments, only by the configuration or `--ignore`.
